description: At night on a rooftop between tall apartment blocks, a young woman in a red slip dress, a black leather jacket, gold chains and chunky white trainers bangs a copper pot again and again with a big wooden spoon, shouting with her mouth wide open. Neighbours in bathrobes and pyjamas stand around her, some covering their ears, some laughing, one holding up pot lids. Pigeons fly up, string lights and a washing line hang overhead, and pans lie scattered on the ground.
